result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles and its existing tests pass. I didn't add a test or run either command by hand, so the dispatch and the `-help` output are untested.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. `usageInfo()` now lists `analyzeLandscape` just before `updateLandscape`, so the no-argument overview shows both.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends both names to `updateLandscape(args)`. For `-help`, it prints the usage of whichever name the user typed, so `updateLandscape -help` prints what it did before.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape`, says `updateLandscape` is the same command kept for existing scripts, and gives an example invocation.
